messages:
olivia: quick ping0: opened PR to make Ruby client streaming reconnect behavior match Go. CI green except windows job failing intermittently. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/1302

diego: can you paste the failing snippet? timeout or assertion?

olivia: timeout inside reconnect loop: `Faraday::TimeoutError: execution expired` after ECONNRESET. passes locally on mac/linux.

ci-bot: windows-ruby-3.1  test-streaming-reconnect failed. logs: https://ci.internal/builds/8009

priya: Windows sockets are finicky. Two quick ideas: use IO.select with a short timeout instead of sleep loops, and set SO_KEEPALIVE on the socket before reads. both helped in other SDKs.

diego: also consider adding a small backoff before reconnect on windows to avoid port exhaustion in CI container.

olivia: adding socket.setsockopt + IO.select and a tiny backoff now. will also add a short "Windows notes" in sampleapp README.

priya: if flakiness persists, gate the test with an env like CI_WINDOWS_FLAKY and file a follow-up issue to investigate root cause across SDKs.

olivia: thanks, pushing commit. looping back here after CI re-run. :fingers_crossed:

ci-bot: olivia pushed commit 5b7c2d. windows job retriggered.

diego: thanks for the quick turnaround. happy to review once green.
